description: This file provides a helper function 'resolveAuthEndpointUrl' that determines the full URL for authentication-related API endpoints. It special-cases certain identifiers to route them to an external domain, based on regex pattern matching, while defaulting to concatenating the provided base URL with the given path for other endpoints.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Computes the full URL for given API endpoints, forcibly routing specific auth endpoints to an external domain based on predefined regex patterns, otherwise concatenating base URL and path.
